[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
Margaret was born on 28 March 1789 and baptised at Kilmarnock on 29 March. The parish transcript names John Glasgow, shoe maker, and Margaret Wyllie as her parents.<ref>[https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBAP%2F3606556&tab=this Findmypast fmp-record-scot-opr-bap-3606556], inspected derivative transcript,25October2026; original register uninspected.</ref>
